overview.title: What is Montelibero?
overview.text: Montelibero is a libertarian free society project in Montenegro, built on voluntary contracts, individual freedom, and decentralized self-organization. Founded in 2021, the community centers on [MTL City](https://montelibero.org/city/) near Bar on Montenegro's Adriatic coast, where an active full-time group lives and builds together. It operates as a DAO-governed intentional community with its own stablecoin (EURMTL), a shared land fund, and internal governance based on the Non-Aggression Principle.

overview.title: Who joins Montelibero?
overview.text: Montelibero draws libertarians, digital nomads, anarcho-capitalists, crypto enthusiasts, and anyone interested in living under voluntary governance structures. The community is international, with a large Russian- and Ukrainian-speaking contingent alongside members from across Europe. Professions represented at MTL City include IT workers, journalists, marketers, teachers, and entrepreneurs - united by shared values around individual sovereignty and non-aggression.

history.text:
Montelibero began with a libertarian couple from Kyiv who relocated to Montenegro in late 2020. By spring 2021 they were joined by like-minded individuals and the movement was formally founded, modeled loosely on the Free State Project in New Hampshire but aimed at building a free society in Europe. The original name was Free Society Project Europe (FSPE), which still appears in the community's branding.

The founding group bought land near Pečurice, Bar municipality and legalized the plot by end of summer 2021. They constructed a private road connecting the site, established the MTL Fund DAO on the Stellar blockchain, and launched the EURMTL stablecoin as the community's internal currency. Land ownership records are anchored on-chain via NFTs, and the fund's 20 largest shareholders form the Board of Signatories through multi-signature governance.

The first MTL City building was completed in summer 2023 and opened for long-term rental, establishing 20+ full-time residents on site. The community opened an artisan workshop at the MTL City community center in June 2025, adding shared workshop facilities. Annual Montelibero Fest gatherings have brought together the broader libertarian movement each autumn since 2023.

location: Montelibero's MTL City is situated near Pečurice and Dobra Voda villages in Bar municipality on Montenegro's southern Adriatic coast (coordinates: 42.0326 N, 19.1636 E). The town of Bar is a short drive away, putting residents close to beaches, a ferry port, and everyday amenities. The site currently covers approximately one hectare with plans for a townhouse district, a commercial and office quarter, and private detached houses. A privately-built road connects MTL City to the surrounding network. Most non-MTL-City community members live in and around Bar, where regular community gatherings take place.
duration: Montelibero is an open-ended permanent community with no fixed program length or membership term. Residents relocate to Montenegro under standard local visas: registering a Montenegrin company is the most common path to a 1-year renewable residence permit. A 5-year digital nomad visa is also available for those who can document monthly income of EUR 1,315 or more. Remote participation is fully supported through the MTL DAO and Telegram community - you can hold EURMTL, vote in governance, and attend the annual Fest without ever relocating.

EURMTL marketplace (MTL Agora) accepted across community businesses
Regular MTL community breakfasts every Wednesday and Saturday in Bar

Privately-built road connecting MTL City to the public road network

howToEnter.text:
Participation is open to anyone who shares the movement's principles. The easiest first step is creating a wallet through [the MTL Wallet bot on Telegram](https://t.me/MyMTLWalletBot), which provides a Stellar-based account and access to the EURMTL ecosystem. To participate in governance and receive dividends, buy MTL tokens - which function as shares in the MTL Fund - through the same bot or the Stellar DEX. You can also request a small free sample of MTL tokens to explore how the DAO works.

To join the physical community in Montenegro, registering a local company is the most common path to a 1-year renewable residence permit. Regular MTL breakfasts (Wednesdays and Saturdays in Bar) and the annual Montelibero Fest are accessible entry points for meeting the community. Reach the team via [@mtl_helper_bot](https://t.me/mtl_helper_bot) on Telegram or at media@montelibero.org.

faqs.question: What is Montelibero and where is it based?
faqs.answer: Montelibero is a libertarian free society experiment based in Montenegro. Its primary physical hub is MTL City near Bar on the Adriatic coast, though community members also live throughout Montenegro and participate remotely via the DAO. The official site is [montelibero.org](https://montelibero.org/).

faqs.question: Do I need to move to Montenegro to participate in Montelibero?
faqs.answer: No. You can join the MTL Fund DAO, hold EURMTL, participate in on-chain governance, and attend annual events without relocating. The Telegram community has around 2,900 members globally and the DAO includes 205 MTLA participants and 379 MTL Fund DAO participants. Physical relocation is optional but enables full participation in on-site life at MTL City.

faqs.question: How do I get started with Montelibero?
faqs.answer: Start by creating a wallet through [@MyMTLWalletBot on Telegram](https://t.me/MyMTLWalletBot). This gives you a Stellar-based account, access to EURMTL, and the ability to buy MTL fund tokens. You can also request a small free sample of tokens to see how the DAO works from the inside. For relocation, visit [montelibero.org](https://montelibero.org/) for guides on establishing residency in Montenegro.

faqs.question: What is EURMTL and how does it work?
faqs.answer: EURMTL is Montelibero's stablecoin, pegged 1:1 to the Euro and issued on the Stellar blockchain. It functions as the community's internal currency, accepted at the [MTL Agora marketplace](https://montelibero.org/eurmtl/) and at community events. You can convert EURMTL to euro cash in Montenegro via [@eurmtl_bot](https://t.me/eurmtl_bot) on Telegram, and exchange it peer-to-peer through the @eurmtl_club channel.

faqs.question: What visa options are available for living in Montenegro through Montelibero?
faqs.answer: The most common approach is registering a Montenegrin company, which grants a 1-year renewable residence permit. A 5-year digital nomad visa is available for those who can show monthly income of EUR 1,315 or more. Montenegro is outside the EU, making residency relatively accessible for most nationalities. Foreign residents with limited Montenegrin income sources may qualify for favorable tax treatment - consult a local specialist.

faqs.question: What is the Montelibero Fest?
faqs.answer: Montelibero Fest is an annual gathering that brings together community members, international guests, and speakers on freedom, governance, and self-organization. The 2023 edition ran September 23 at MTL City - the first international libertarian festival in Montenegro. The 2024 edition ran October 4-6 across Bar and MTL City. The 2025 edition (Montelibero.Zajedno) ran November 27-28 at Kings Park Hotel in Podgorica, with a wrap-up party at MTL City. A 2026 edition has not yet been announced as of this update. Admission has historically been free with advance registration required.

faqs.question: What is the MTL Fund and how do MTL tokens work?
faqs.answer: The [MTL Fund](https://mtl.montelibero.org/) is a DAO investment corporation that holds assets including cash, Bitcoin, gold, land, and equipment. MTL tokens function as shares in the fund. Holders receive monthly dividends in EURMTL based on fund performance. The 20 largest token holders form the Board of Signatories, which manages the fund via multi-signature blockchain transactions. Tokens trade freely on the Stellar DEX and can be purchased or sold at any time. As of the latest report, the fund holds approximately 4,260,000 EURMTL in consolidated assets.

faqs.question: How many people live in MTL City full-time?
faqs.answer: As of early 2024, 20+ residents live full-time at MTL City. The broader Montelibero Telegram community has around 2,900 members, and the MTLA and MTL Fund DAOs each have hundreds of on-chain participants. The per-site resident count is intentionally kept accurate; broader Montenegro-wide community size has not been independently confirmed.

faqs.question: Is Montelibero only for Russian or Ukrainian speakers?
faqs.answer: No. The community has a large Russian- and Ukrainian-speaking contingent reflecting its founding origins, but English is widely used and the movement actively seeks international participation. The annual Montelibero Fest features programming in both Russian and English, and there is a dedicated English-language Telegram channel for the community.

faqs.question: Can I buy land or property at MTL City?
faqs.answer: Property purchases at MTL City are handled through the MTL land fund using EURMTL. Past transactions have included individual land plots and apartments in the first completed building. The land acquisition program was resumed in 2025. For current availability, contact the team via [@mtl_helper_bot](https://t.me/mtl_helper_bot) on Telegram or at media@montelibero.org.
